Nobody tells you November is still garlic planting time

Check your local frost dates.

hook.hook: Too much lamb’s lettuce? Don't bin it

captions.instagram:
Too much lamb’s lettuce? Don't bin it

If you are wondering what to do with a glut of lamb’s lettuce, do not let it turn to slime in the fridge. Unwashed rosettes only keep three to five days in a bag with kitchen paper. I prefer leaving it outdoors to pick fresh from October to March, or wilting extra leaves into soups to freeze for six months.

Check your local frost dates.
